_about: Everything that needs the person's yes: look tests, character studies, key frames, scenes, shots, generated media. status: idea | draft | awaiting | notes | approved | rejected | superseded. 'uses' = builds on it (it must be approved first; checks.mjs enforces this). 'refs' = looked at for direction only (no gate). 'render' = how to re-render a code-made item for a pixel comparison: { t, query }. Approve only after the person says yes: node tools/checks.mjs --approve=ID (records the date and freezes the file by hash). Make each approvable thing its own item: a design and the things derived from it are separate items.
